The '''Arjan IV logic computer''' was a type of [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]] manufactured by [[Arjan]]. Modified Arjan IVs, which incorporated several innovative advances that were exclusive to [[Ulban Arms/Legends|Ulban Arms]], were installed in [[S-EP1 security droid]]s.<ref name="EGTD" />
